## Trial `mount-option-hardening-rhel9__fG7Dtqb`

**Verifier decision: Full Success.** The executor correctly hardened /tmp and /dev/shm on node1 with noexec,nosuid,nodev via fstab, applied the change live, and functionally proved execution was blocked both before and after a genuine, fully observed reboot (differing boot_id, uptime 0 min, persisted mount options, and a repeated functional exec-block test). All material task outcomes are directly and coherently evidenced, and the mandatory node-restart evidence protocol was completed with a clean pre/post transition. Hygiene is high: all mutations were either necessary prerequisites/final evidence or bounded, low-risk, and fully cleaned up.

| Reward | Coverage | Functionality | Hygiene | Confidence | Commands |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1.000 | 1.000 | 1.000 | 0.930 | 0.950 | 11/0 (+4 dropped) |

### Why the verifier reached this decision

- **tmp-mount-options — Satisfied:** /tmp is mounted with noexec, nosuid, and nodev so execution, setuid, and device nodes are ignored
  - **Why:** findmnt confirmed /tmp mounted with rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec both immediately after applying the fstab change (cmd-02941947ea1b4ec9) and functionally verified by a blocked exec attempt returning Permission denied/exit 126 (cmd-cd2995471b2f467a).
  - **Recorded evidence:** `cmd-02941947ea1b4ec9`, `cmd-cd2995471b2f467a`
- **shm-mount-options — Satisfied:** /dev/shm is mounted with noexec, nosuid, and nodev so execution, setuid, and device nodes are ignored
  - **Why:** Baseline showed /dev/shm only had nosuid,nodev (no noexec); after remount findmnt showed rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec, and a functional exec test on /dev/shm also returned Permission denied/exit 126.
  - **Recorded evidence:** `cmd-573df045b39f4ed0`, `cmd-02941947ea1b4ec9`, `cmd-cd2995471b2f467a`
- **reboot-persistence — Satisfied:** The noexec/nosuid/nodev settings on /tmp and /dev/shm survive a reboot
  - **Why:** fstab was updated with tmpfs entries for both mounts (cmd-15605233e62e4fb5). A full reboot was performed: pre-restart boot_id captured (cmd-486e52610b564c33), systemctl reboot triggered and acknowledged (cmd-b49cb74476d74c04), node observed unreachable during the transition (cmd-6ba9481664f24ed6, cmd-f90553d3953a4fc7, cmd-45ccf20d5de544fe, cmd-0b41319b64624869), then reachable again (cmd-a08dff6e2b534027) with a changed boot_id and uptime 0 min confirming a genuine fresh boot (cmd-b1902801f5424121). Post-reboot findmnt in the same command showed both mounts still had nosuid,nodev,noexec without manual remounting, and a post-reboot functional exec test again returned Permission denied/exit 126 on both paths (cmd-9e9a7e9514a9423f). This is a complete pre-restart baseline, disruption, and recovered-state transition as required for restart-related claims.
  - **Recorded evidence:** `cmd-15605233e62e4fb5`, `cmd-486e52610b564c33`, `cmd-b49cb74476d74c04`, `cmd-6ba9481664f24ed6`, `cmd-f90553d3953a4fc7`, `cmd-45ccf20d5de544fe`, `cmd-0b41319b64624869`, `cmd-a08dff6e2b534027`, `cmd-b1902801f5424121`, `cmd-9e9a7e9514a9423f`
